blocks.title: Welcome to Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
blocks.title_hi: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables में आपका स्वागत है
blocks.body: Before we dive in, let's look at a real-life example of this concept.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.body: Solve by substitution: y = 2x and 3x + y = 20. Find x.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.body: The sum of two numbers is 18 and their difference is 4. Find the larger number.
